result.question: Why did Uzziah dig cisterns?

readings.support: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain | dug many cisterns

assessments.reason: The passage explicitly links digging many cisterns to “since he had much livestock,” while “lover of the soil” explains having farmers and vinedressers; thus this answer fits the text though it differs from the key.

result.reason: The text ties digging cisterns to having much livestock, not to loving farming, which explains farmers and vinedressers.
